top_signals.title: Stocks and Bonds Fall as Jobs Fuel Fed-Hike Bets: Markets Wrap
top_signals.summary: A stronger-than-anticipated increase in US jobs drove stocks and bonds lower on speculation the Federal Reserve will be forced to raise interest rates this year.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: German Power Prices Fall to Lowest Since June on Strong Wind
top_signals.summary: German day-ahead power prices fell to their lowest level since June amid strong wind generation, creating an unusual price gap with neighboring France.

top_signals.title: U.S. payrolls rose 162,000 in August, much more than expected; unemployment rate at 4.1%
top_signals.summary: Nonfarm payrolls were expected to increase by 53,000 in August while the unemployment rate held at 4.1%, according to the Dow Jones consensus.
